markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_Freestanding_Doors
markers.note: Eighteen doors standing in open ground. Each leads to a different one of the others.

markers.name: INT_The_Bed_in_the_Field
markers.note: Sleeping here moves you to a different part of the reality. You do not choose which.

markers.name: INT_The_Teacher
markers.note: Asks about an exam you have not studied for. Will not be reasoned with.

markers.name: INT_Melting_Staircase
markers.note: Softens under weight. Two players are too many.

markers.name: INT_The_Phone_That_Rings_Backwards
markers.note: You speak first, then it rings.

markers.name: INT_Familiar_Room
markers.note: It is your trailer, wrong in three details.

markers.name: INT_The_Long_Corridor
markers.note: Gets longer the faster you run down it.

markers.name: INT_Mask_Rack
markers.note: Wearing one changes how NPCs across the reality address you.

markers.name: INT_The_Waking_Bell
markers.note: Ejects you home immediately, gently. The only polite exit in the multiverse.
